question: vLLM logprobs memory overhead throughput degradation benchmark

sources.title: [Performance]: large rate of decrease in generation throughput ... - GitHub
sources.snippet: In vllm==0.4.1 and 0.4.2, there is a large rate of decrease in the generation throughput when SamplingParams.logprobs increases. It can get as low as 1 token/s using meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct on an A6000 with engine_args.max_logprobs == sampling_params.logprobs == len (tokenizer.vocab.keys ()) which is 128256 for llama-3.
